cue: Staging an existing research snapshot from a shared working checkout for publication.
fire_when: The shared source README says no interval is claimed while main has a complete newer certificate, as measured for T039 target2.
silent_when: Only named new files are staged in an isolated checkout and the existing scientific snapshot matches the verified main manifest.
text: Before staging a shared research directory, compare its snapshot manifest with current main. A stale local copy can revert a newer certificate. Stage only named files and preserve the newer scientific payload unless an explicit reviewed replacement is intended.
evidence: logs/ARCHIVE_RECONCILIATION.json: main b606e61034a9a93c11a2d36e715e38419e45b24c preserves 383e86e6b61bf225dc61f41e8450666180b514bd; logs/ARCHIVE_SHARED_CHECKOUT.jsonl records older local README.
